nodes.label: Development PostgreSQL + pgvector Service
nodes.rationale: Deliberately optional: the reference development environment uses a natively installed PostgreSQL, so this file is a convenience and not a requirement. The application creates its own schema on first use, so the service only needs to exist. Has a pg_isready healthcheck and a named volume for data.

nodes.label: pgvector Image Tag Pinning Intent
nodes.rationale: The comment states the image is pinned by digest because pg16 is a moving tag and an unannounced pgvector or server upgrade underneath a populated volume is not something to discover during an incident. The actual image line is `pgvector/pgvector:pg16` — the tag, not a digest — so the stated intent and the config disagree. PROJECT_STATUS.md §8 and §14 corroborate this: the digest is explicitly listed as not pinned, deprioritised because the compose file is now a secondary path.

edges.source_location: compose header points readers at the README for the reference native-PostgreSQL setup this quick start assumes
The single pgvector-enabled Postgres it provisions is the whole storage tier the one-datastore decision assumes
